name: install_plugin
description: Ask the user to install a first-party Cursor marketplace plugin. Prefer the kebab-case slug when known; display names also resolve. Opens the install confirm tray and BLOCKS until the user confirms or cancels, so call it only when the plugin is actually needed to continue. Unknown or ambiguous names fail without showing anything. Never claim a plugin was installed unless this tool reports it.
